items.title: Set the brief
items.body: Market position, target age, gender split, regions and brand tone. Takes about two minutes.

items.title: We score the overlap
items.body: The engine compares your campaign against real artist audience data, not follower counts.

items.title: Get a ranked shortlist
items.body: Every match comes with a score and the signals behind it, so you can defend the pick.

fields.tones: Confident, Refined, Creative, Understated, Culturally relevant

fields.heading: Beyond demographics. We match on meaning.
fields.bodyOne: Most platforms stop at audience numbers. But a perfect demographic overlap means nothing if the brand tone clashes with the artist's identity. Audiences notice, and so does performance.
fields.bodyTwo: Fanbased evaluates the qualitative signals that traditional tools can't measure. Brands justify every partnership with transparent reasoning. Artists protect their authenticity with data, not just gut feel.
